The `v0.8.1` release (commit `808d7861bb8ebbaef866ced799f2850137d48078`: decision
reviewer lane #134, routing-coverage fix, reconsideration fallback fix) plus llm-mailroom
PR #135, merged on the PR branch so one commit carries both. Return to a release tag
once #135 is released.

Changes originate in the authoritative standalone repository, are committed and
reviewed there, then consumed here. Never patch this snapshot or export hub
changes back into the owning repository. After importing the same revisions,
the Digital-Mailroom workspace and these generated snapshots must match.

Dojo owns scoring; llm-mailroom owns the pipeline. Production corporate v6
and sandbox evaluation v7 remain separate intentional prompt catalogs.

PR #135 contributes
the sorter handoff to decision backends, the classification arbiter, and the frozen
sorter prompt V15 (class boundaries B1-B3, subclass conventions S1-S5) with its
subclass catalog rendered from the Dojo sorter guide
(`langchain_agents/prompts.py`, `langchain_agents/doc_inventories.py`).

The pipeline declares llm-dojo-scoring 0.25.0 (release `v0.25.0`, commit
`e35504db12f09aeda07ae116663c177acd8c0d6e`: sorter subclass guide, zero-token fix).
